scope: 10 ground missions only: Landing school, Atlantic return, Engine trouble, Absolutely nominal, Fast ferry, Spinning entry, Early engine fade, Late engine fade, Blackout rendezvous, Last-call recovery. Eight unseen starts per mission, four nominal and four with variability 0.4. Other missions remain unverified.

training.method: Full-network reward-only search on calibrated sensory directions, with correlated parameter proposals
training.episodeScope: 720 trials in the final adaptive-attitude lesson; earlier calibration and flight lessons are documented separately

limitations: External decoder learning with a fixed anatomical graph and modeled sensory tuning.
Visible instrument-mediated control, not camera-only navigation.
Eight final starts per mission give limited evidence; failures remain in the report.
No demonstrated mastery of all 27 missions.
No validated prediction of a living fly, measured muscle control, chemical dose or biological learning.

finalPlan.purpose: Independent final JavaScript assessment of the frozen generation-6 candidate across all ten trained missions, with matched visual controls. Report all failures; full 27-mission mastery remains a separate requirement.
finalPlan.protocol: Unchanged full physical flights, cold network each time, auto odor off, style off, gain 1; original endpoints and touchdown requirements.
finalPlan.selection: Candidate frozen before these tests; do not tune or switch checkpoints using this final cohort.

sourceCacheVersionChange.change: Only import and asset cache tags changed after the full JavaScript test; calculations and physical criteria are byte-identical after restoring the tags.
